interventions.detail: Patched gen_images.py: torch.device('cuda') -> cuda if available else cpu
Used uv venv with Python 3.10 instead of the conda environment.yml
Installed CPU torch 2.2.2 from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu and numpy<2 in place of pytorch 1.9.1/cudatoolkit 11.1
Installed setuptools<70 because torch_utils/ops/conv2d_gradfix.py imports pkg_resources
Pre-downloaded the network pickle into DNNLIB_CACHE_DIR=/work/cache/dnnlib, set in env.sh
